title: GTA6 Developer Dispute: Final Hearing Begins in Tribunal
description: The final employment tribunal hearing for 31 fired GTA6 developers versus Rockstar Games begins in Scotland, accompanied by rallies.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Final Hearing Begins in Rockstar Games Employment Tribunal

The employment tribunal involving Rockstar Games and the 31 fired GTA6 developers has reached a crucial stage. According to reports from Eurogamer, the final hearing officially kicked off in Scotland, opening with public rallies and rousing speeches from the affected staff.

### Rallies and Speeches Outside the Hearing

Before the official proceedings commenced, the atmosphere outside was charged. The former developers, who were unceremoniously marched out of the company's offices last October, gathered to voice their concerns. Opening with the powerful rallying cry, "Today, we are fighting fear," the participants demonstrated strong solidarity in pursuing their legal rights and labor protections.

### Context Surrounding the Dispute

This high-profile dispute involving the 31 GTA6 team members has drawn continuous attention from both the gaming community and industry analysts. As anticipation for the upcoming blockbuster remains at an all-time high, the internal challenges and labor dynamics behind the scenes highlight the complex realities often hidden within major AAA game development studios.

As the final hearing progresses in Scotland, observers note that the ultimate outcome of this tribunal could set an important precedent for labor relations and employee treatment within the broader video game industry.

## Editor's Take

The development of GTA6 is one of the most closely watched stories in entertainment, but the human cost behind the scenes deserves equal attention. This final tribunal hearing brings critical labor issues to the forefront. We hope for a fair resolution that respects the hard work of all developers who build the games we love.
